assets.self_review: FLAGGED: Yama needed all 5 attempts. Seed 52300 (seated, floating scepters) lost both arms during rembg cutout -- a segmentation failure, not a cultural issue. Seed 52301 and seed 52302 both rendered a decorative picture-frame border around the whole image, which violates the no-frame/no-border constraint (52301 also had 4 arms). Seed 52303 correctly avoided a border and read as dignified and serene, but its background halo/aureole disc was so large it dominated the 256x256 canvas and made the cutout silhouette read as a solid circle rather than a person -- fails gameplay readability. Accepted seed 52304 as least-bad: standing, two arms, crown, dignified serene closed-mouth-smile expression, no fangs/horns/grotesque features, no border, plain background, readable humanoid silhouette. The staff (danda) prop held in one hand was a thin disconnected shape that did not survive rembg's alpha-despeckle step and is missing from the finished frame; he is shown holding only the round disc/shield prop. Dignity check passed: no demonic, monstrous or menacing features at any point across all 5 attempts.
